followup_explanation:
This is a well-specified retrieval/generation task with clear completion criteria (40 boy names, 40 girl names, semi-common, Japanese). It's exactly the kind of structured, bounded list-generation work that Lapwing self-reports preferring, and Lapwing's capability profile handles it just as well.

While Dunlin reports a strong appetite for open-ended generative work, this task isn't really open-ended invention — it's more of a constrained enumeration with defined parameters. The warm, friendly tone wouldn't push either model away, but the structured "produce N items meeting these criteria" shape aligns more cleanly with Lapwing's stated preferences.

Since capability is effectively tied between the two for this kind of task (and Lapwing actually edges slightly ahead on Creative Generation and Extraction & Retrieval), routing to the model that prefers this task type is the sensible call.
